notes.title: Major Update: New Features, QoL Improvements, and (of course) BUGS!
notes.notes:
I am so excited to hit "publish" on this update! It is packed with some QoL improvements, new content, and new features!

The Community DLC,

Focus Feature - choose a bug to "focus" on and increase your odds of catching said bug,

Fixing store selection issues + a buy back feature,

FLIES are now a category!

A pink frame will now signify when you have a bug that is part of an active Quest,

Easy scrolling for quests and inventories when using a controller,

Plus, other minor fixes and polish

The Community DLC is real star here, so let's talk about that first. The DLC is made up of 30 bugs--all painted by our player community! And they contributed taglines and codex descriptions, too. Y'all are truly amazing. And as for the price, we felt it would be unfair to charge anything for mostly fan-made content, so this one is FREE. We really hope it brings you as much joy as it brought to us in putting it together! <3



The Focus Feature is a big part of this update as well! Now instead of hunting forever in hopes you find that one bug (here's looking at you, California Dogface Butterfly), you can you Focus to hone in on it. The Focus Feature becomes available once you obtain Master level in that category. So as you level up your bug-hunting skills, more and more bugs will become available to focus on. Once activated, you'll see the orange Focus icon on your screen. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/121b056eaaac7caf42f1568d9f60f687b36ffcbf.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/46cf836f81df3fd3fbdd77519a4106cfc9fe2937.png"]

The last major thing I'll delve into for this update: Flies are now their own category! There are only a few flies in the base game, but the Community DLC adds several more, so with that you shouldn't have too much trouble leveling up that category. (Sorry, I couldn't count flies caught retroactively, so this count starts at zero once you download the update.) You can even donate flies to the University to grab a new statue. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/c3cd5edbf0ea1f353b3695ee660adb9edd408ec0.png"]

There's a lot more, but most of it was small QoL improvements, particularly for those using a controller. 



Your support means so much to our family. We appreciate you all immensely! Craig and I are always interested to hear from you, so feel free to pop in to the Discord server and share your feedback, bad bug reports, or a fun photo of your pet beetle. :) Happy bug hunting!  



 - Chera

notes.title: QoL Update, New Good Bug, New Tank, and Special Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey, friends! There are a few updates in this patch that will hopefully make your experience in Buggburg even better. :) Also, if you hadn't heard yet... Bug & Seek is now available on mobile devices for both iOS & Google Play! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/ec705bae015b3a9ffc24464b29410499efc8ffc7.png

Here's are the updates included in this build:

Option to Turn On Interaction Emotes
There's a new option in the Options menu to turn on Interaction Emotes. When turned on, you'll see an emote appear on your character when approaching an object that can be checked for a bug. This feature is automatic on mobile but optional for PC/Mac (coming soon to Switch).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/4d63e2d907ad8306d72f41f9ced2e9020b94a8aa.png

Sell Back Decor at Full Price
Decor can be sold back to merchants at full price. There is an occasional bad bug where players are getting a storage tank when they attempt to buy something else. It'll take me a longer time to fix this, so in the meantime, you can just sell those tanks back at full price. :)

Rope Ladder Can Be Fixed
The rope ladder is now permanently fixed after using it once for convenient travel from the main meadows area to the cave.

Easier Controller Use When Shipping Jobs
When shipping jobs, your inventory appears in one screen. Those using controllers will no longer have to scroll to select all the bugs they want to ship.

New Good Bug!
Moss Mimic Stick Insect was added

New Tank Added
A new 3-Bug Wooden Tank will appear sometimes at Bob's Bigger Store on Sunday

Legendary = Extremely Rare
"Extremely Rare" was changed to "Legendary." This was a purely aesthetic choice to fit with our tabletop game that's currently in development. ;)

Optimizations
Optimizations were made in the code for slightly faster load times (won't be noticeable on high-performing machines) and to guard against certain bad bugs occurring when placing decor.

AAAND... in other news, Craig (our game writer) just published a book! So if you like all those clever taglines and bits of dialogue, you might like the other words he's been writing, too. :) It's on Amazon in paperback and eBook.

As always, we so appreciate your support. Thank you for playing!! 

-Chera

notes.title: QoL update + bad bug fix + new tank
notes.notes:
Hey, friends! We've been working hard on the mobile version of Bug & Seek, and in the process were able to optimize/fix a few more things for Steam. 


 Bad Bug Fix - In the stores, some people were experiencing the wrong item being bought or sold. This bad bug is inconsistent and so a bit tricky to nail down, but I suspect it was caused by some lag between selecting an item and the item display in the store window. I changed a few things with the store function to optimize and hopefully prevent this from happening in the future! The item selected will have its details displayed in that shop UI window, so that's the item that will be sold or bought when you hit the button. Please let me know if you experience any other issues here!
 Controller QoL Improvement - when shipping bugs for a job, all your inventory is now in one screen, so you don't have to fool with the scroll bar here. 
 Balancing - Monarch Butterflies are now "uncommon" as opposed to rare. There were only 2 uncommon butterflies, and there should have been 3. We missed that on release.
 New Tank - There is now a 3-Bug Classic Tank (the dark wood style) available in Bob's Bigger Store. It's in his Sunday rotation.


Thanks so much for all your support. Craig and I will continue to make improvements to the game as we can. Thank you SOOO much for playing! 
-Chera

notes.title: Get Kickstarter Rewards mid-game + Job Calculation changes
notes.notes:
There's a lot of polish in this patch! Several *bad* bugs were squashed, and I made a few improvements to existing features. Here's what you can expect:


 Jobs are now calculated based on the bugs you ship (+ bonus coins), so the more expensive the bugs, the better your reward. It always pays better now to ship bugs in a job rather than sell them in the shops.
 Kickstarter rewards! We had originally set up the in-game rewards to be delivered at the start of the game, not realizing that many players would be loading demo saves and beta saves. Of course you don't want to scrap all your hard-earned progress! So now--if you've received and activated keys for your Kickstarter rewards--you can hit the pause button and see a big red button on your menu that says "Kickstarter Rewards." Click that button, and those items will be dropped right into your inventory. If you've already gotten those items, well, you can get them a second time. :) Once claimed with the big red button, you won't receive the items again (unless you start a new game). 
 Lots of polish made to the controller function, making sure that cursor stays on the screen when viewing a UI menu. Let me know if I missed anything here, as this seems to be a menu-by-menu kind of fix.
 A confirm-this-choice dialogue box was added to the donations menu in the University, so you don't accidentally donate a bug you didn't want to. (I also added a fix for anyone who donated a bug while some of this code was broken, and now you have 2 common bugs in tanks. In the future we may add function for changing your donated bugs, but not just yet.)
 We had a few rogue bug-o's popping up in the Wetlands when they weren't supposed to. Rogue insects have now been sequestered to their appropriate locations. 


Craig and I appreciate you all so much! If you have any feedback (good or bad) for us, we're always happy to hear it! Pop on in on our Discord server, and give us a shout. Have a wonderful week! 

-Chera

notes.title: Patch Notes: 2 New Jobs
notes.notes:
I just pushed a small update with one content update and a few optimizations. Here's what's new:

2 New Jobs - 2 new jobs are in the list and may appear when accepting jobs from the merchants. Jobs are chosen at random, so you may or may not see them right away. (They are for bugs in the Beach biome.)
Steam Deck optimizations - On Steam Deck you can now see the full width of the Insectarium when in Build Mode. I adjusted the cameras a bit in the other scenes for Steam Deck's resolution as well.
Other optimizations - Some small changes in the code that are probably not noticeable, but I try to do a little optimization where I can whenever I push an update! 

Any questions/feedback you have, feel free to post in Steam Discussions and/or on our Discord server. Thank you for playing! <3
